name: [REBIRTHS] Slime Seas ⚔️ Anime RPG
desc:
BETA

Enter a fast-paced open world adventure where progression, crafting, upgrading, combat, and PvP all come together. Defeat increasingly powerful slimes, gather materials, and turn your loot into powerful gear as you push further through the worlds!

🗺️ Explore  12 Islands🔨 Craft ✨ Upgrade 💥 Battle ⚔️ PvP 👥 Guilds 💰 Trading

Current Fruits: Lightning, Volcano, Javelin, Cannon, Star, Shadowstep, Spike, Firestorm, Thunderlord
Note: Fruits spawn every 60 min and despawn after 20 min
